2607.08974.title: CLAP: Direct VLM-to-VLA Adaptation via Language-Action Grounding
2607.08974.paper_summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic capabilities from pretrained VLMs, yet large-scale post-training on robot data and architectural modifications can reshape the backbone so extensively that it becomes difficult to isolate what the VLM contributes to control. Directly converting pretrained VLMs into VLAs with minimal architectural change offers a more transparent path to understanding how VLM capabilities transfer across model scales. The core obstacle is output-distribution mismatch: predicting actions as bare numeric token sequences moves generation away from the VLM's pretrained language distribution, degrading the capabilities we seek to preserve. To address this, we propose CLAP (Causal Language-Action Prediction), which prepends each numeric action sequence with a natural-language action description, causally conditioning precise action-token prediction on a language-action plan without modifying the backbone architecture. With single-epoch fine-tuning alone, 2B CLAP achieves 90.8% on LIBERO (+14.9 pt over VLA-0) and improves robustness on LIBERO-PRO under language, object, and spatial perturbations. We will release CLAP at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B as an open-weight, multi-scale compact VLA family from a single VLM lineage, enabling controlled analysis of VLM-to-VLA capability transfer.
2607.08974.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動模型（VLA）從預訓練的 VLM 繼承語義能力，但對機器人數據的大規模後訓練和架構修改可能會廣泛重塑主幹，使得難以隔離 VLM 對控制的貢獻。將預訓練的 VLM 直接轉換為 VLA，並進行最小的架構變更，提供了一條更透明的途徑來理解 VLM 能力如何在模型規模之間轉移。核心障礙在於輸出分佈不匹配：將行動預測為純數字標記序列會使生成遠離 VLM 的預訓練語言分佈，降低我們希望保留的能力。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 CLAP（因果語言-行動預測），它在每個數字行動序列前添加自然語言行動描述，因果地將精確的行動標記預測與語言-行動計劃相連，而不修改主幹架構。僅通過單次訓練，2B CLAP 在 LIBERO 上達到了 90.8%（比 VLA-0 高出 14.9 點），並在語言、物體和空間擾動下提高了 LIBERO-PRO 的穩健性。我們將以 0.8B、2B 和 4B 的開放權重、多尺度緊湊 VLA 系列發布 CLAP，這些模型來自單一的 VLM 系譜，能夠進行 VLM 到 VLA 能力轉移的受控分析。
